reason: A DSH dashboard plugin that aggregates local session usage and presents token statistics through interactive charts and summary metrics.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 中聚合本机会话的模型用量，并通过悬浮入口和数据仪表盘展示令牌统计与趋势图表。
summaries.en: Aggregates model usage from local DSH sessions and presents token statistics, trends, and model breakdowns in an overlay dashboard.

capabilities: Reads local DSH session model usage data
Aggregates token, message, session, and model statistics
Serves aggregated statistics through a local GET API route
Displays usage metrics and charts in a dashboard overlay
